title: 置顶会话 → 再取消置顶
description: 挑一个真实会话，从行内「…」菜单置顶，验证它进入置顶区；再取消置顶，验证回到普通列表。
preconditions: 至少有一个未置顶会话。
expectations: 置顶后数据库 pinned=1，侧边栏「置顶」分组出现该会话
菜单第二次打开时显示「取消置顶」而不是「置顶」
取消后 pinned=0，会话回到原分组

db.sql: SELECT title FROM (SELECT title FROM threads WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status != 'deleted' AND pinned = 0 AND archived_at IS NULL AND title NOT IN (SELECT name FROM workspaces) ORDER BY COALESCE(last_message_at, updated_at) DESC LIMIT 8) WHERE length(title) <= 16 LIMIT 1

steps.note: 行内操作按钮悬停后才可见
会话行菜单：重命名 / 置顶 / 归档 / 删除

db.sql: SELECT pinned FROM threads WHERE title = '{{target}}' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
db.message: 数据库里该会话已置顶

assert.message: 已置顶时菜单提供取消置顶

db.sql: SELECT pinned FROM threads WHERE title = '{{target}}' AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
